THE FIRST USEFUL RESULT

What happens before data appears?

The screen should explain readiness in everyday language. These are planned steps, not completed actions or a functioning onboarding workflow.

  1. 01

    Confirm your business and access

    Sign in, select an organization you belong to, and let the server check your permissions.

    NOT AVAILABLE
  2. 02

    Authorize the software connection

    BAGDigital should enroll a permitted Housecall Pro credential through a protected process. Never paste API keys into this page.

    GATED
  3. 03

    Verify one read-only request

    After infrastructure and security approval, check only authorized company information using the approved GET /company operation.

    NOT VERIFIED
  4. 04

    Show what is truly ready

    Display safe connection metadata and verified read capabilities. Jobs, estimates, webhooks and writes remain separately gated.

    COMING LATER

DESIGN STATES / NOT LIVE DATA

What you'll see as setup progresses

ALL THREE ARE ILLUSTRATIONS
STATE A / DEFAULT EXAMPLENOT CONNECTED

No records shown · No workflows available
STATE B / HYPOTHETICALREVIEW REQUIRED

Status-only proof · Writes still disabled

BUILT WITH BOUNDARIES

Your software. Your permissions.

Never expose your API key

Provider secrets stay in a controlled backend vault—not in a browser form or dashboard.

Read-only means read-only

Verification does not authorize editing customers, invoices, schedules or other business records.

Each business stays separate

The eventual app checks organization and workspace membership on the server before returning information.

Internal prototype. No customer names, provider responses, login mechanism, payment flow, production connection or operational data are present. Product availability remains subject to independent verification and release approvals.
